title: The Asking to Sit with the Quiet Group
youtube_title: The Asking to Sit with the Quiet Group | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Speaking up once, softly, can open a door.
summary: At a music corner with a drum and a recorder, Jorie feels shy about asking to sit with the group that was already talking. Instead of pretending not to care, Jorie tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie Luz stays kind and does not push for a show.
